# MyCurling.com

> > Your comprehensive resource for curling information, including equipment suppliers, club directories, association listings, and how-to guides for players across North America and internationally.

MyCurling.com serves as a central hub for the curling community, featuring directories of Canadian and international clubs, equipment manufacturers like Asham and BalancePlus, retailers such as Atkins Curling Supplies and Curling Depot, and educational resources covering everything from ice sheet specifications to bonspiel planning.

## Getting Started with Curling

- [MyCurling.com - All the information on curling you need!](https://mycurling.com): Homepage for curling info: how-to guides, physics, Canadian clubs directory
- [The curling Sheet](https://mycurling.com/Articles/curlingsheet.html): Standard curling ice sheet dimensions, house, tee line, button specs
- [Organizing a bonspiel](https://mycurling.com/Planning_Bonspiels/pbonspiel.html): Bonspiel planning guide: teamwork, duties, weekend tournament organization

## Curling Clubs & Associations

- [Canadian Curling Associations](https://mycurling.com/Curling_Associations/Canada): Canadian curling associations: Alberta, BC, Ontario, Manitoba, Quebec orgs
